Topic: Provide mechanisms to skip repeated content
Do: Provide a visible 'Skip to main content' link at the top of the page.
Ensure screen readers can detect skip link navigation.
Ensure skip link remains visible when focused.
Provide a logical focus order for skip links.
Allow users to skip navigation menus and repetitive sections.
Implement ARIA landmarks for assistive technologies.
Use clear and descriptive labels for skip links.
Ensure skip link works across all browsers.
Place skip link before repeated navigation elements.
Use CSS to make skip links visible on focus.
Ensure that focus correctly lands on main content.
Test skip link using keyboard only navigation.
Add multiple skip options if there are long sections.
Ensure skip link is not hidden using display:none.
Ensure link destination uses an ID or named anchor properly.
Dont: Don’t use JavaScript-only navigation without fallbacks.
Don’t place skip link after the main content.
Don’t use duplicate IDs for skip targets.
Don’t disable focus outlines for skip links.
Don’t use confusing skip link text like 'Click here'.
Don’t break focus when skip link is activated.
Don’t make skip links that don’t work on keyboard.
Don’t put skip link inside hidden containers.
Don’t change URL hash without focus adjustment.
Don’t depend on JavaScript scroll for skip actions.
Don’t style skip link invisibly on focus.
Don’t make skip link navigate to wrong section.
Don’t use role='presentation' on key landmarks.
Don’t assume users will know about skip links.
Don’t remove skip links from mobile view.
Don’t add multiple conflicting skip links.
Don’t hide skip link behind overlays.
Edge cases: Skip link scrolls to the target but focus remains on the link
Sticky header covers the skip target after jump
Skip link exists only on desktop and not on mobile
Multiple skip links exist but all point to the same ID
Skip link's target is inside an iframe with different origin
Skip link text duplicated leading to confusion in screen readers
Focus moves outside viewport after skip on zoomed pages
Skip link target is hidden via aria-hidden='true'
Animation or scroll smoothing steals focus after skip
Skip link added by CMS only on certain templates
Skip link interferes with keyboard shortcuts of widgets
Skip link is present, but the main content is not properly landmarked
Screen reader reads skip link as 'link' without description
Focus jumps to the target but content is loaded lazily and empty
Skip links break when CSS custom properties alter positioning
Navigational landmark duplicated (two role='main') causing confusion
Skip link appears in DOM after header due to server rendering race
Mobile assistive tech ignores skip link due to touch-first behavior
